properties.text: Russian forces continued limited offensive operations southeast of Borova on July 14 but did not advance.[38] Russian Subordinate Main Effort #3 – Donetsk Oblast Russian objective: Capture the entirety of Donetsk Oblast, the claimed territory of Russia’s proxies in Donbas, and advance into Dnipropetrovsk Oblast Russian forces advanced southeast of Slovyansk.

ISW has not observed evidence of Ukrainian forces operating in Pazeno (southeast of Slovyansk) or north and northwest of the settlement since January 14, indicating that Russian forces likely advanced in the area on a prior date.
Ukrainian forces recently advanced in the Oleksandrivka direction.

The Russian Ministry of Defense (MoD) claimed that Russian forces conducted a Geran drone strike against a gas distribution station in Kramatorsk.[37] Russian forces continued offensive operations in the Dobropillya tactical area and the Pokrovsk direction on July 11 and 12 but did not advance.[38] Neither Ukrainian nor Russian sources reported ground activity in the Novopavlivka direction on July 12.

[26] A Russian milblogger claimed that Russian forces advanced north of Volokhivske, south of Volokhivka, south of Okhrymivka, and south of Chaikivka (all northeast of Kharkiv City).[27] Russian forces continue offensive operations in the Velykyi Burluk direction on July 10 and 11 but did not make confirmed advances.

The Donetsk Oblast Prosecutor’s Office reported that Russian forces carried out seven airstrikes against Kramatorsk and Bilenke (immediately east of Kramatorsk) on July 10, killing four civilians, including a child, and injuring nine civilians.[42] Russian forces continued offensive operations in the Dobropillya direction on July 10 and 11 but did not advance.
